name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v538: Fast Cloudflare solve - fail fast. (1) Reduced Cloudflare poll timeout from 120 seconds to 30 seconds - the invisible WebView either solves quickly or fails fast instead of waiting 2 minutes. (2) If the headless solve fails, it falls back to the visible sheet so the user isn't left with a silent no-op. (3) All v537 fixes retained: always require cf_clearance, removed dead JS cookie probe, clear in-flight bypass on dismiss, background API config load, tightened WebView security, removed double-poll. (4) All v536 fixes retained: alpha=0 invisible attach, isUsableClearance, Domain=.host cookie clearing.
